outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); there is no quantification plot showing averaged data.
Panel B includes two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D includes bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity showing means with error bars and sample sizes noted in the bars, but individual data points are not shown.
Panel E shows FACS histogram distributions (cell counts vs TMRM intensity), which are distribution plots rather than bar charts of averages, so individual point overlay is not required.
